title: Shiokaze v1 (plain)
comment: A pitch bend, CC1, and CC64 demo in 1980s city pop style, 16 bars at 116 BPM in F major. The alto sax scoops into phrases, falls and doits off phrase ends, and has delayed vibrato on long notes. The fretless bass slides between roots. The Rhodes comps dry in bars 1-8 and pedals broken chords from bar 9. This is the plain version, with the same notes and no automation. Instead of the pedal, the Rhodes notes from bar 9 are lengthened.
